newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Roller proposes 3 for 1 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Roller proposes 3 for 1 rights issue.

text.p: Roller International said on Monday it was proposing a three for one rights issue in February 1997.
The directors said unaudited net deficit for the six months ended September 30 was NZ$20,000 (1995 net deficit $38,000).
This was arrived at after writing off acquisition costs relating to the purchase of the Centrepoint Resort Hotel of $56,000, deduction of interest charges of $81,000 and depreciation of $29,000.
Gross profit from the operations of the total for July, August and September amounted to $300,000 and interest received was $34,000.

Roller said it expected the rights issue to enable the repayment of all debt relating to the acquisition of the hotel. Given similar trading conditions next year, it expected the hotel to operate at a satisfactory profit level and said the company should start to generate taxable profits.

Roller International entered into an agreement to acquire all the shares in Smartlink Holdings Limited, the wholly owned subsidiary Flexiplan Holidays Limited, a wholesale travel operator. The price will range from $2 million to $2.5 million.
It will be satisfied by the issue of fully paid ordinary shares in Roller International at $1.10 each.
The issue will be fully underwritten by Salinek Holdings and the underwriting agreement will also require shareholder approval. The rights issue will raise approximately $3.7 million.
An EGM to approval the purchase and underwriting agreements will be held on February 3.
